title: Tesla Opens Cybercab Pre-Orders for Personal Use
excerpt: Tesla has started accepting pre-orders for the Cybercab for personal use, featuring a $299 monthly fee and geographic restrictions.
body_html:
Tesla has officially opened pre-orders for its Cybercab model for personal use. The upcoming vehicle comes with a monthly fee of $299, though Elon Musk acknowledged that this price point is considered too high.

The pre-order rollout includes specific geographic restrictions regarding where the vehicles can operate. Further details on availability and full operational capabilities were not immediately detailed in the announcement.
